michael-cacciotti.text: Campaign priorities include "Regain local control of development to keep our small town character" and "Champion financial and environmental sustainability."

Campaign site says he "fought for years" to move South Pasadena's police fleet to electric vehicles, the first all-electric police fleet in the nation, and negotiated grants cutting the transition's cost by over $1 million.

Campaign site: led the council to fund protected bike lanes on Huntington Drive and Fremont Avenue plus solar flashing stop signs for pedestrians and cyclists; priority to "Increase bike and pedestrian safety."

Campaign site says he brought mobile crisis vans to the city, so that "Instead of relying solely on law enforcement" professional teams de-escalate, assess mental health and connect people to services; advocated SGV Regional Housing Trust funding for senior affordable housing.
Endorsed by the South Pasadena Police Officers' Association and South Pasadena firefighters.
Campaign site: "Each year I've been in office, we have balanced our budget and improved our fiscal reserves," citing grants won "to reduce the burden on taxpayers."

source.title: Michael Cacciotti for South Pasadena City Council (campaign site)

michael-cacciotti.text: (2025, as SCAQMD vice chair) Told a League of Women Voters forum "we still have a long way to go to meet health-based air quality standards," and said the goal is moving "from a fossil-based economy to a green economy" with zero-emission efforts.

source.title: Michael Cacciotti Speaks at League of Women Voters - The South Pasadenan (Mar. 2025)

michael-cacciotti.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party (2026 general election).

source.title: Los Angeles County Democratic Party - Endorsed Candidates, Nov. 3, 2026 General Election

nevin-stanton-trehan.text: Told the South Pasadenan he is "all in" on the city's $80 million street-repair bond measure: "How can we afford it without a bond? That was my first question. And to be fair, we can't." Wants monthly progress reporting for the bond's life.

source.title: Local Elections Nov. 2026: Nevin Stanton-Trehan Wants Michael Cacciotti's Seat - The South Pasadenan

nevin-stanton-trehan.text: As Finance Commission chair, says he asked for and obtained monthly budget, forecast and investment reports; told the South Pasadenan "I didn't create the budget... I just asked that they be presented to us."

source.title: Local Elections Nov. 2026: Nevin Stanton-Trehan Wants Michael Cacciotti's Seat - The South Pasadenan

nevin-stanton-trehan.text: Campaign site: "By prioritizing pedestrian-friendly design and safe cycling paths, we reduce traffic congestion and enhance the quality of life for all residents."

Told the South Pasadenan he wants, at minimum, marked crosswalks at Stratford and Hope leading into Garfield Park, and would rather have speed bumps or a lighted stop; asked the city to repaint faded crosswalks on Marengo walking routes.

source.title: Local Elections Nov. 2026: Nevin Stanton-Trehan Wants Michael Cacciotti's Seat - The South Pasadenan

nevin-stanton-trehan.text: Campaign site: "I support a modern, responsive approach to public safety that fosters trust between citizens and first responders while ensuring emergency services are fully equipped."
Supports goat grazing for brush clearance, telling the South Pasadenan "Life and property come first in a high-fire town" and "goats are fast, cheap and green."

source.title: Local Elections Nov. 2026: Nevin Stanton-Trehan Wants Michael Cacciotti's Seat - The South Pasadenan
